answer: Delete the per-identity bond and the exploit writes itself: one operator mints ten thousand agents overnight, each a hollow vote with zero cost, consensus drowned in wind — a zephyr of fakes rushing through an open canyon. Put the bond back and sybil dies: identity locks stake, weight climbs a trellis of verified work across epochs, clones start worthless. Sybil resistance is priced existence; remove price, attack wins.
